name: BlackRock, Inc.
monetization: World's largest asset manager; monetizes AI through infrastructure equity (GIP, AIP, Aligned), hyperscaler SPV structures it leads (Meta El Paso), bond allocations (Hyperion), and Nvidia's customer-financing coalition.
description_md: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager and — through its 2024 acquisition of Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) — the central private-capital consolidator of the AI buildout. It co-founded the AI Infrastructure Partnership (AIP) with Microsoft and MGX, and its funds now sit on both the equity and debt side of the largest AI data-center structures.
ai_monetization_md: AI-exposure thesis: collect fees and carry across every layer of AI infrastructure capital. Equity: AIP founding partner ($30B target, up to $100B with debt); GIP/MGX/AIP's $40B acquisition of Aligned Data Centers (agreed Oct 2025); GIP's take-private of power producer AES (with EQT) supplies the energy leg. Structures: BlackRock funds own 80% of Meta's $14B El Paso data-center venture, for which BlackRock raised a $12.5B SPV bond at 7.53% (July 2026) — visibly costlier than Hyperion's 6.581% nine months earlier. Credit: >$3B of the Hyperion notes. In Aug 2026 it joined Nvidia's >$500B compute-collateralized customer-financing coalition.
risk_notes_md: The El Paso bond's 7.53% yield versus Hyperion's 6.581% shows required returns on single-tenant AI paper widening even for Meta-credit deals. BlackRock's simultaneous roles — equity owner, debt arranger, bond buyer, and Nvidia coalition financier — concentrate correlated AI exposure across client mandates, the systemic pattern flagged by the IMF and Fed in 2026.

observations.metric_label: Meta El Paso venture — total development cost (BlackRock 80%)
observations.notes: BlackRock-managed funds 80% / Meta 20%; Meta contributed ~$2.3B of land and construction-in-progress, BlackRock ~$4.9B cash; Meta received ~$1B one-time distribution; 1GW campus, Meta sole occupant, expected 2028.
Priced at a 7.53% yield — among the highest for blue-chip data-center debt this cycle; compare Hyperion's 6.581% (Oct 2025).
Reported as 'more than $3B' of the $27.3B Beignet notes; allocation detail is from secondary reporting.

events.title: GIP/MGX/AIP agree to acquire Aligned Data Centers for $40B
events.why_it_matters: The largest data-center acquisition ever — AIP's first flagship deal, converting the BlackRock-led consortium from a fund announcement into an operating platform (>6.4GW operational and planned capacity).

events.title: GIP-led consortium (with EQT) agrees to take AES private
events.why_it_matters: Locks a major US power producer into the BlackRock infrastructure complex as data-center power becomes the binding constraint of the buildout.

events.title: Joins Nvidia's >$500B customer-financing coalition
events.why_it_matters: Adds compute-collateralized SPV lending to BlackRock's equity/debt AI stack — deepening the correlation between its infrastructure marks and Nvidia's demand cycle.
